plain_english_policy: This bill directs that a specific portion (20%) of oil and gas tax revenue collected by Citronelle be allocated to two local entities: an official volunteer fire department/rescue squad and an official historical society. A three-person board is established to manage these funds, which must be held in interest-bearing accounts before being distributed on a dollar-for-dollar matching basis to the organizations.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would legally mandate that Citronelle distribute 20% of its oil and gas tax proceeds (capped at $2,000/month per entity) to designated volunteer fire/rescue services and a historical society. It creates an administrative board to oversee this distribution and declares these organizations as quasi-public entities eligible for public funds.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsor advanced legislation establishing a specific funding mechanism for local volunteer services and historical preservation within Citronelle.
evidence_quotes: "Twenty percent (20%) of all tax proceeds... shall be paid to the board established by this act"
"allocate said the money to the City of Citronelle's official volunteer rescue squad fire department and official historical society on a dollar for dollar matching fund basis"
